moving.setup.title: Already use Nocturne on your phone?
moving.receive.title: {name} has its own memory. Move it here?
moving.receive.lead: This computer becomes its home: it reads, tidies and writes the page. {name} then works with it like your other phones.
moving.receive.already: This computer already holds a memory. A computer holds one person’s memory. Move {name}’s here and put what is here aside, or keep what is here and move nothing.
moving.receive.putAside: Put this aside and move it here
moving.receive.checking: Checking · every count must match before {name} lets go of it
moving.arrived.title: The memory from {name} is here.
moving.arrived.body: Reading carries on from where it was. Nothing is read again.
moving.arrived.online: To have answers written online here, set up Online answers in {settings}.
moving.phone.found.title: Move your memory to {computer}?
moving.phone.found.lead: {computer} becomes the home of your memory. It reads, tidies and writes your page from now on.
moving.phone.found.then: This phone then works with {computer}: keep, ask and read your page from here.
moving.phone.found.one: Your memory lives in one place at a time, so it moves rather than copies.
moving.phone.size.title: What moves
moving.phone.size.bytes: About {size}, most of it photos and recordings
moving.phone.size.time: About {minutes} minutes on this connection. Keep Nocturne open; it carries on if the phone allows.
moving.phone.size.after: Your memory here is put aside once it has arrived. You choose then whether to remove it.
moving.phone.moving.title: Moving your memory
moving.phone.moving.note: You can still keep things. They go across at the end.
moving.phone.moving.stopAsk: Stop moving? Nothing has changed here, and {computer} keeps nothing of it.
moving.phone.paused: Moving paused. It carries on when {computer} is back.
moving.phone.notWhole: Something didn’t arrive whole, so nothing changed. Try again.
moving.phone.outdated: Update Nocturne on {computer}, then try again. Nothing was changed.
moving.phone.moved.title: Your memory is on {computer}.
moving.phone.moved.body: {count} things arrived, and every count matches. This phone now works with {computer}.
moving.phone.moved.keep: Keep it put aside for 30 days
